title: Playground Chrome Reliability
description: Fix broken window chrome in wgpu playgrounds (navbar, window borders, tabs/chips, sizing). Harden AppBuilder registration so malformed layouts are impossible. Replace free-form panel group strings with PanelGroup enum.
summary:
Fixed wgpu playground window chrome regressions where scene content painted over dock tab caps, borders, navbar, and footer. Added DockState::paint_chrome on the overlay draw list after window content; moved navbar/footer to overlay; folded Window Options/Command chips always use main draw list.

Hardened the single app registration path: AppBuilder::build_definition() now asserts non-empty unique window kinds, non-empty body keys, and layout window_kind_id cross-references via collect_window_kind_ids_from_layout(). Introduced PanelGroup enum (Workbench, Details, Display, Settings) replacing free-form panel group strings; migrated all 24 plugins.

Verified: framework + all 24 plugin unit tests pass; procedural3d wasm32 release build; wgpu renderer wasm build.
